quality_control.notes: Signed contracts do not establish performance, payment, or Brandon Andersen as the personally assigned DJ.

quality_control.performer_display_name_policy: When contracts name AJ Hawn, publicly display DJ Hawn Solo (stage name supplied by Brandon Andersen), preserving AJ Hawn as the source name.
quality_control.attribution_policy: For reviewed DJ-service contracts with no individual performer named, presume Brandon Andersen based on his own account, explicitly labeled owner presumption rather than documentary proof. Never apply presumption to unreviewed or non-DJ records.
